description: This script generates a build stamp file containing the current timestamp and the current Git HEAD commit hash. It provides functions to resolve the Git HEAD and to write the build info into a JSON file inside the 'dist' directory.

methods.name: resolveGitHead
methods.description: Retrieves the latest Git commit hash (HEAD) in the current or specified directory.

methods.name: writeBuildStamp
methods.description: Creates a build stamp file containing build timestamp and Git HEAD hash inside the 'dist' directory.
